items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: She came back to Chicago with the band.

ctx.x: Yes. He was with us in the Dreamland and he went to San Francisco with us and then he quit out there and they sent for Baby Docs. Baby Docs joining us out there. Yeah, Baby Docs joining us out there. So, they stayed out there another year and that's when Gonzalez came back. She came back to a... Oh, wait,
Yeah, she came back to Chicago with the band.
